definitions.enrollment: Preliminary K–12 enrollment; preschool excluded. Not finalized 2026–27 enrollment.
definitions.map: 2025 charter-level MAP Proficient + Advanced counts divided by reportable students × 100. Suppressed components are never reconstructed.
definitions.demographics: 2025 DESE charter-level percentages from the supplied cohort master. IEP incidence is the source field, not independently recalculated.
definitions.frl: 2025 reported FRL count / January membership, not preliminary K–12 enrollment. Network percentages are ratios of summed counts over the same records.
definitions.growth: 2025 APR building ALL growth Target designations / eligible buildings. Positive points possible, reported earned points and designation define eligibility; Participation remains eligible, and On-Track does not count as Target.
definitions.map_comparison: Only exact 2025 subject/group/grade matches with fully published components are used. Aggregate classifications additionally require all grades to reconcile to the already-published aggregate counts. This is descriptive attainment above a matched state benchmark, not an official school target or causal sponsorship effect.

directory_conflicts.detail: DESE Kansas City charter webpage reverses the Armour IMS/IHS codes; dated directory PDF, cohort workbook and APR agree on IMS=1910 and IHS=1920. Those verified data identifiers are preserved.
DESE St. Louis charter webpage lists 6966 for City Garden EAEC; dated directory PDF, cohort, demographic, MAP and APR sources use 6956. Do not substitute the webpage code.

The dated directory and DESE charter webpage identify 2800 E. Linwood Boulevard, replacing the undated workbook address 6409 Agnes Ave. The webpage building grade label K–4 conflicts with PDF PK–05; dated directory grades are shown separately from 2025 APR grades.
Dated PDF retains ZIP 64113-1205 for IHS while the charter webpage uses 64111 for Armour. Street-address sharing is recognized without resolving this ZIP discrepancy.

Dated PDF repeats 1618 Tower Grove as a second address for the Folsom building. Primary Folsom address is corroborated by the charter page; secondary line is retained as a source conflict, not a second campus.

Charter webpage grade spans differ from dated PDF: Frontier 3935 webpage 4–8 vs PDF 06–08; Frontier 6975 webpage PK–3 vs PDF PK–05; Académie Lafayette 6941 webpage K–5 vs PDF PK–05. Dated PDF spans control the displayed directory.

rejected_sources.reason: Conflicts with explicit 2024–25 statistics fall K–12 total 856,222; snapshot enrollment is not used as the K–12 denominator.

public_source_verification.refresh: Fetch official sources, prepare the reference snapshot, then rebuild. No network access is required at runtime or during ordinary offline builds.
